deliverables.name: female-rain.png
deliverables.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: temporary cafe study scene illustration for a website; standalone art only.
Style/medium: semi-realistic digital illustration: an illustration made more realistic through subtle anatomy, tactile surfaces, believable rain and soft natural lighting. Retain a quietly painterly drawn quality. Approachable faces, restrained expressions; not exaggerated anime, not a photograph.
Composition/framing: one separate landscape 3:2 image, close diagonal front view of a seated person studying, centered subject. Compose for a future narrow portrait crop through the center: keep face, hands, reference book and notebook in the middle 45 percent of the image. Show head, shoulders, bent forearms, and tabletop. Eyes remain lowered toward the reference book and notebook, no eye contact. Other customers and a staff member appear very softly in the distant background.
Lighting/mood: rain outside, cozy and contemplative, private concentration. Muted blue gray rainy daylight against warm wood and gentle amber lamplight. Subtle reflections and tactile materials.
Constraints: ordinary nonsexual seated study scene. Anatomically natural hands, only two arms. No user interface, buttons, borders, panels, captions, words, readable writing, lettering, logos, watermarks. Books and notebooks contain only faint indistinct page markings. No horror, glitches, supernatural effects, dramatic action, or direct gaze. Only one sharply depicted main character.
Scene/backdrop: a rainy, dark, intimate retro Japanese cafe. A rain-streaked window beside the table, dark aged wooden furniture, softly lit vintage pendant lamp, indistinct muted street lights outside, subtle worn leather in the distant seating. The quiet atmospheric solitude of Serial Experiments Lain, interpreted as a comfortable grounded cafe scene with no horror. Background customers and a staff member are soft and unobtrusive.
Subject: a high-school-age Japanese girl strongly inspired by Lain Iwakura from Serial Experiments Lain, with a short dark chestnut bob, understated asymmetrical fringe, a small slim strand beside one cheek, dark brown eyes, delicate natural proportions and a quietly thoughtful face. She wears fully covering soft brown bear hooded pajamas, with the hood up framing her bob and two small rounded plush bear ears; a modest loose cozy fit, cream inner hood, no bare shoulders or exposed torso. This is an ordinary nonsexual study scene. She is reading an open reference book while writing in her notebook, focused downward.
